card.name: Words right before a company or maker name
card.fires_on: Small words like by, to, formerly, contact or an opening bracket that come just before a company, manufacturer or army name. Seen in compatibility contact lines and in cartridge or brand histories.

card.writes: It seems to push toward the start of a proper name such as a company or organisation.
card.plain: It fires on the little word just before a company or maker is named.
